scope: The standing Achimota School Administration Block in Accra, including its clock tower, arched main frontage and attached ranges.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The original school campus is still standing. It includes the Administration Block as a separate named facility.
The tour navigation from the Administration Block connects to the ground floor, Guggisberg Street, and the Science Department. Only the public navigation text and named connections were used.
